title: Daedalus-150M: A Convolution-Attention Hybrid Designed for CPU Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.20210v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Small language models are usually built like large ones and then squeezed onto a CPU afterwards. We did the opposite: we fixed the target first, one user, one token at a time, 4-bit weights, ordinary CPU, and chose the architecture to suit it. The result keeps full attention in only 6 of its 18 blocks. The other 12 use short convolutions whose memory is two timesteps wide no matter how long the conversation gets, so two thirds of the network never re-reads a growing cache.   Trained from scratch on 59.9B tokens, the model scores 47.31 on a five-task benchmark against a bar of 42.20 that was fixed before training began. It beats GPT-2 124M, Pythia-160M, OPT-125M and GPT-neo-125M, all trained on three to six times more data, and exceeds MobileLLM-125M's published score despite that model seeing a trillion tokens. translated_title: Daedalus-150M：一种为CPU推理设计的卷积-注意力混合架构
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.20210v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：小型语言模型通常像大型模型一样构建，然后在之后被压缩到CPU上。我们反其道而行之：我们首先确定目标——一个用户、一次一个令牌、4位权重、普通CPU，然后选择适合它的架构。结果在18个块中仅6个保留了完整的注意力机制。其余12个使用短卷积，其记忆宽度为两个时间步长，无论对话多长，因此网络的三分之二永远不会重新读取不断增长的缓存。该模型从头开始在59.9B个令牌上训练，在一个五项基准测试中得分47.31，而训练前设定的基准为42.20。它超越了GPT-2 124M、Pythia-160M、OPT-125M和GPT-neo-125M（这些模型均在3到6倍的数据上训练），并且超过了MobileLLM-125M的已发布得分，尽管后者看到了万亿个令牌。验证字节每比特为0.8685。为了检验架构而非训练配方，我们训练了一个传统的全...
tldr: 该论文提出一种针对CPU推理优化的卷积-注意力混合架构，仅用6个注意力块和12个短卷积块，在少量数据上训练即超越多种更大模型，实现了高效推理和卓越性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a convolution-attention hybrid architecture optimized for CPU inference, using only 6 attention blocks and 12 short convolution blocks, which surpasses larger models with less training data, achieving efficient inference and superior performance.
